register_note: Human review and signoff register. This is the ONLY place an approval can be recorded, and only a human writes it. The deterministic pipeline never populates a decision here: it cannot mark anything approved, assessed, certified, or compliant. Each entry records a reviewer's explicit decision on one assurance-graph node, the evidence hashes they reviewed, and when. An empty reviews array is the correct state for a template; it means nothing has been human-reviewed yet.
package_signoff_note: Package-level provider signoff, distinct from per-node reviews above. A single approved node is NOT package approval. Only a human sets this. `sdr.py preflight` requires decision=approved AND release_tag matching the current artifacts/release-manifest.json before it will report submission ready. Left null in the template.

package_signoff.decision: TBD: approved | rejected (a human sets this; the pipeline never does)
package_signoff.reviewer: TBD: name and role of the provider signer
package_signoff.timestamp: TBD: ISO-8601 timezone-aware datetime of signoff
package_signoff.release_tag: TBD: release_tag from artifacts/release-manifest.json this signoff covers
package_signoff.package_manifest_sha256: TBD: hash of the release manifest reviewed
package_signoff.notes: TBD: scope of what was reviewed
